resources.description: List of X resource entries for gmemusage, each with a name and value string. Entries must match documented resource names and types from gmemusage(1). Only 'name', 'display', 'geometry', 'font', 'background', 'update', 'threshhold', 'ncolors', 'color[1-9]' are valid names (case-sensitive, matching manpage class names in parentheses). Values are string representations as used in X resource files (e.g., '320x400', '5', '400', 'red/maroon'). For booleans, use 'True'/'False' strings (though gmemusage has no boolean resources). Colors use X color names, optionally with fallback in parentheses per manpage examples. All values are strings; numbers are quoted as needed per X convention (e.g., '5' for seconds). Threshhold is spelled with two 't's as in the manpage. 'color4' through 'color9' may be omitted by leaving their entry out of the list (not required). The 'update' interval uses integer seconds as per default 5. The 'geometry' value is in X geometry format: WxH+X+Y or WxH. The 'font' is an X font name string, default 'fixed'. The 'background' is an X color name, default 'grey4'. The 'name' resource is the resource class name, default 'Gmemusage'. The 'display' is optional and may be omitted by excluding it from the list; if present, it is a string like ':0.0'. All values must be strings, even for numeric resources like 'ncolors'. The list must contain only valid resource names and may omit optional color resources beyond color3 if unused. No extra resources are documented and should not be added.
